doc: Index of pack.bin (built by scripts/build_collage_pack.py; see its header). Each piece is a PNG or JPEG at [offset, offset+len) of pack.bin; tiers l, m, s are at most 480, 240, 120 px high; lines = ink over transparency, sil = the outline (1 bit), cloth = the clothing (1 bit). The grain is a mask painted at grain_opacity.
